'''Darvin''' will be the clan chief of the [[Reyn]] Aiel seventeen years after the [[Last Battle]]. He is seen by [[Aviendha]] in the [[Glass columns]] of [[Rhuidean]].

Darvin attends the meeting where the Aiel decide to go to war with the [[Seanchan]] and [[Padra]] thinks he and [[Tavalad]] are the only ones not convinced by the decision.
